an4.139:1.1: Cattāro 'me bhikkhave dhammakathikā. Katame cattāro? Idha bhikkhave ekacco dhammakathiko appañ ca bhāsati asahitañ ca, parisā ca na kusalā hoti sahitāsahitassa. Evarūpo bhikkhave dhammakathiko, evarūpāyaṃ parisāyaṃ dhammakathiko t' eva saṅkhaṃ gacchati.
an4.139:2.1: Idha pana bhikkhave ekacco dhammakathiko appañ ca bhāsati sahitañ ca, parisā ca kusalā hoti sahitāsahitassa. Evarūpo bhikkhave dhammakathiko, evarūpāyaṃ parisāyaṃ dhammakathiko t' eva saṅkhaṃ gacchati.
an4.139:3.1: Idha pana bhikkhave ekacco dhammakathiko bahuñ ca bhāsati asahitañ ca, parisā ca na kusalā hoti sahitāsahitassa. Evarūpo bhikkhave dhammakathiko, evarūpāyaṃ parisāyaṃ dhammakathiko t' eva saṅkhaṃ gacchati.
an4.139:4.1: Idha pana bhikkhave ekacco dhammakathiko bahuñ ca bhāsati sahitañ ca, parisā ca kusalā hoti sahitāsahitassa. Evarūpo bhikkhave dhammakathiko evarūpāyaṃ parisāyaṃ dhammakathiko t' eva saṅkhaṃ gacchati. Ime kho bhikkhave cattāro dhammakatthikā ti.
